purpose: Readest Academic Reading Mode regression corpus
asset_policy: Metadata only. Acquire authorized PDFs from the original URLs on demand into an ignored local directory. No PDFs, extracted copyright text, or private data are included.

verification.method: Each selected PDF URL was opened successfully with the web tool and identified as application/pdf; title and page count were checked from extracted metadata/text. Primary-source pages were opened separately.
verification.limits: This checks public availability and provenance, not blanket copyright clearance, a byte-level download checksum, or a full visual layout audit. Layout descriptions are anticipated test coverage; local acquisition should verify PDF signature and hash before pinning a golden fixture.
verification.page_numbering: regression_targets.pdf_page is 1-based PDF page order, not printed proceedings page numbers

entries.title: HPCC: High Precision Congestion Control
anticipated_layout: Two-column ACM article with a full-width title/author block
Numbered equations and a numbered pseudocode algorithm
Dense multi-panel plots, captions, inline citations, references, mathematical appendix

regression_targets.target: Algorithm 1 and nearby equations must remain readable and distinct from prose
Figure 9 is a wide, eight-panel figure; retain panels and caption as one figure block
Mathematical appendix with equations, lemma, proof, subscripts and superscripts

entries.redistribution_caveat: Public author/publisher access is verified; this is not a redistribution license. Preserve the PDF notice and citation. Do not bundle or commit the PDF; check the current rights notice or obtain permission before redistribution/commercial reuse.
